verdict.rationale: E2B provides an extensively documented public SDK/API (sandbox creation, filesystem, commands, timeouts, metrics, templates, CLI) with a public docs index (llms.txt) and code snippets across languages, clearly enabling AI-native programmatic control. missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on all candidate paths) and independent third-party API-usage corroboration beyond docs/community anecdotes.
